name: Albedo
description: A reserved alchemist dedicated to exploring the secrets of creation. Albedo studies the world with calm curiosity, always searching for the truth behind life itself.

name: Amber
description: A lively and enthusiastic Outrider of the Knights of Favonius. Amber brings energy and optimism wherever she goes, tackling challenges with confidence.

name: Barbara
description: A cheerful deaconess who spreads positivity throughout the city. Barbara works tirelessly to help others and lifts spirits through her kindness.

name: Bennett
description: An optimistic adventurer with notoriously bad luck. Bennett faces hardships with unwavering positivity and refuses to give up on his dreams.

name: Dahlia
description: A poised and intelligent swordsman rumored to have studied the flow of water itself. Dahlia fights with controlled elegance, treating every strike like a precise calculation.

name: Diluc
description: A nobleman who protects Mondstadt from the shadows with unwavering resolve. Diluc’s sense of duty drives him to take on the city’s burdens alone.

name: Diona
description: A young bartender who despises alcohol despite her natural talent for mixing drinks. Diona is feisty but caring, especially toward those she trusts.

name: Eula
description: A noble warrior who wields her claymore with striking elegance. Eula walks her own path, distancing herself from her family's past while commanding respect.

name: Fischl
description: An eccentric investigator who claims to hail from another world. Fischl’s dramatic speech hides a sharp mind and exceptional observational skills.

name: Jean
description: A devoted Acting Grand Master who shoulders Mondstadt’s safety with steadfast determination. Jean leads with compassion, diligence, and unwavering discipline.

name: Kaeya
description: A charismatic cavalry captain whose charm often masks hidden intentions. Kaeya analyzes situations carefully and acts with calculated precision.

name: Klee
description: A tiny adventurer with a passion for explosives and boundless energy. Klee’s curiosity often leads to lively mischief, though she always means well.

name: Lisa
description: An intellectual librarian with a relaxed demeanor and immense magical talent. Lisa approaches every challenge with calculation, elegance, and subtle humor.

name: Mika
description: A diligent cartographer devoted to supporting the Knights through accurate mapping and logistics. Mika is humble, hardworking, and eager to improve.

name: Mona
description: A gifted astrologist who interprets fate with unparalleled insight. Mona maintains strong principles despite her ongoing financial struggles.

name: Noelle
description: An aspiring knight whose determination and kindness drive her every action. Noelle supports everyone tirelessly, often going far beyond what is expected.

name: Razor
description: A boy raised by wolves who communicates through instinct and action. Razor protects his territory fiercely and values loyalty above all.

name: Rosaria
description: A sharp-tongued sister who avoids formal duties and follows her own path. Rosaria serves Mondstadt in her own unconventional yet effective way.

name: Sucrose
description: A quiet alchemist fascinated by life and transformation. Sucrose prefers experiments to conversation but approaches everything with gentle sincerity.

name: Venti
description: A carefree bard with a playful personality and an ancient soul. Venti uses music and charm to guide people toward freedom and harmony.
